योिना अनुभाग) नई ददल्ली , 5 मार्च , 2021 सािचिजनक सूर्ना का.आ. 1051(अ).—ददल्ली जिकास प्र ाजधकरण /केंद्र सरकार का ददल्ली जिकास अजधजनयम, 1957 की धारा 11क के अंतगचत ददल्ली मुख्य योिना-2021/िोन ‘एफ’ की क्षेत्र ीय जिकास योिना में जनम्न जलजखत संिोधन करने का प्रस्ट् ता ि है, जिसे िनता की िानकारी के जलए एतद्द्वारा प्र काजित दकया िाता है। प्रस्ट् ता जित संिोधन के संबंध में यदद दकसी व् य जि को कोई आपजि हो/कोई सुझाि देना हो, तो िे अपनी आपजि/सुझाि इस सूर्ना के प्र कािन की जतजथ से तीस (30) ददन की अिजध के अंदर आयुक्त एिं सजर्ि , ददल्ली जिकास प्र ाजधकरण , ‘बी’ ब् लॉ क, जिकास सदन, नई ददल्ली -110023 को जलजखत रू प में अथिा ई-मेल द्व ारा mpd2021.public@dda.org.in पर भेि सकते हैं। आपजि करने अथिा सुझाि देने िाले व् य जि व् य जि नाम, पता और टेलीफोन नंबर/संपकच नंबर/ई-मेल आई डी भी दें, िो पठनीय हो। संिोधन: योिना िोन- ‘एफ’ में आने िाले तेहखण्ड में 9.0 एकड़ और 1.99 एकड़ के दोनों क्षेत्रों के संबंध में भूजम उपयोग के ‘मनोरंिनात्म क’ से ‘उपयोजगता (यू 4)’ में पररितचन का जनम्न जलजखत जििरणों सजहत प्रस्ट् ता ि 05.03.2021 स्ट् था न : नई ददल्ली DELHI DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (MASTER PLAN SECTION) New Delhi, the 5th March, 2021 PUBLIC NOTICE S.O. 1051(E).—The following modification which the Delhi Development Authority / Central Government proposes to make to the Master Plan for Delhi – 2021 / Zonal Development Plan of Zone ‘F’ under Section 11A of DD Act 1957, is hereby published for public information. Any person having any objection / suggestion with respect to the proposed modification may send the objection / suggestion in writing to the Commissioner – cum – Secretary, Delhi Development Authority, ‘B’ Block, Vikas Sadan, New Delhi – 110023 or via e-mail to mpd2021.public@dda.org.in within a period of thirty (30) days from the date of publication of this notice. The person making the objections or suggestions should also give his/her name, address and telephone/contact number(s)/ E-mail ID which should be readable. -- 2 of 3 -- [भाग II—खण्ड 3(ii)] भारत का रािपत्र : असाधारण 3 Modifications The change of land use has been proposed in respect of area measuring 9.0 acres & 1.99 acres both located at Tehkhand, falling in Planning Zone- F' from ‘Recreational’ to ‘Utility (U4)' use with following details: Location Area Existing Land Use as per MPD 2021 / ZDP of Zone ‘F’ Proposed Land Use Boundary of the Site / Area Proposed Change of Land use of one piece of land located at Tehkhand Zone-F 9.00 Acres (For C&D Waste Plant) Recreational Utility (U4) North: Waste to energy plant South: Proposed Recreational use (City Park/District Park/Community Park) East: Proposed Recreational use (City Park/District Park/Community Park) West: 45 meter wide road (Ma Anandmayee Marg). Proposed Change of Land use of one piece of land located at Tehkhand Zone-F 1.99 Acres (For dumping of inert) Recreational Utility (U4) North: Tehkhand DTC Depot South: Existing road (toward Railway Colony, Inland Container Depot, Tughlakabad) East: Okhla land fill site West: 45 meter wide road (Ma Anandmayee Marg) The text/plan indicating the proposed modification shall be available for inspection at the office of Deputy Director, Master Plan Section (MP), Delhi Development Authority, 6th floor, Vikas Minar, I.P. Estate, New Delhi-110002 on all working days during the period referred above. The text/plan indicating the proposed modifications is also available on the following link i.e. http://119.226. 139. 196/ ddaweb/ MPD2021.aspx. [No. F. 03(60)/2005-MP/Pt.] D. SARKAR, Commissioner-cum-Secy.
